hypotheses.description: get_func_args_dict relies on inspect.signature's default annotation evaluation and only guards against ValueError. On Python 3.14, PEP 649 lazy annotations are resolved while building the signature, so a TYPE_CHECKING-only annotation such as scrapy.Request is not present in the function's globals and raises NameError. The missing handling is in scrapy/utils/python.py: no annotation_format=inspect.Format.FORWARDREF is passed and NameError is not caught, and this propagates through argument_is_required into MiddlewareManager._check_mw_method_spider_arg.
